rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for someone receiving medical care, including a new patient at a clinic.

example.english: This patient is seeing a doctor for the first time.
example.traditional: 呢個病人第一次嚟睇醫生。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 beng6 jan4 dai6 jat1 ci3 lai4 tai2 ji1 sang1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who can wait calmly or work steadily without becoming frustrated.

example.english: He is patient, teaching me for a whole hour without getting angry.
example.traditional: 佢好有耐性，教咗我成個鐘頭都冇鬧人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3 gaau3 zo2 ngo5 sing4 go3 zung1 tau4 dou1 mou5 naau6 jan4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone keeps calm and does not lose their temper while waiting or under pressure.

example.english: The game is not over yet, so you have to be patient.
example.traditional: 比賽仲未完，你要沉得住氣。
example.jyutping: bei2 coi3 zung6 mei6 jyun4 nei5 jiu3 cam4 dak1 zyu6 hei3

rows.note: Use this for the persevering side of “patient,” especially persistence in a long-term effort rather than waiting.

example.english: He is patient and persistent about learning the piano, and has not given up after three years.
example.traditional: 佢有恆心學琴，學咗三年都冇放棄。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 hang4 sam1 hok6 kam4 hok6 zo2 saam1 nin4 dou1 mou5 fong3 hei3
